claim_1.claim: Ex vivo IFN ELISpot assay analysis of fresh peripheral blood mononuclear cells from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intradermal MVA85A (n = 12) at screening and 1, 2, 4, 12 and 24 weeks post-vaccination showed that Ag85A-specific IFN responses peaked at day 7 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both intradermal and intramuscular MVA85A induced high levels of Ag85A-specific IFN at the peak (day 7) time-point.

claim_2.claim: Ex vivo IFN ELISpot assay analysis of fresh peripheral blood mononuclear cells from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intramuscular MVA85A (n = 12) at screening and 1, 2, 4, 12 and 24 weeks post-vaccination showed that Ag85A-specific IFN responses peaked at day 7 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both intradermal and intramuscular MVA85A induced high levels of Ag85A-specific IFN at the peak (day 7) time-point.

claim_3.claim: Ex vivo IFN ELISpot assay analysis of fresh peripheral blood mononuclear cells from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intradermal MVA85A (n = 12) at screening and 1, 2, 4, 12 and 24 weeks post-vaccination showed that Ag85A-specific IFN responses stayed significantly above baseline at 24 weeks post-vaccination (day 168) compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: The responses were durable, staying significantly above baseline six months post-vaccination (Wilcoxon matched pairs test).

claim_4.claim: Ex vivo IFN ELISpot assay analysis of fresh peripheral blood mononuclear cells from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intramuscular MVA85A (n = 12) at screening and 1, 2, 4, 12 and 24 weeks post-vaccination showed that Ag85A-specific IFN responses stayed significantly above baseline at 24 weeks post-vaccination (day 168) compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: The responses were durable, staying significantly above baseline six months post-vaccination (Wilcoxon matched pairs test).

claim_5.claim: Ex vivo IFN ELISpot assay analysis of fresh peripheral blood mononuclear cells from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intradermal MVA85A (n = 12) and intramuscular MVA85A (n = 12) at screening and 1, 2, 4, 12 and 24 weeks post-vaccination showed no significant difference in Ag85A-specific IFN responses between the intradermal and intramuscular groups.

sources.quote: The median antigen-specific IFN response in the intradermal group exceeded that of the intramuscular group (Fig. 3) but this difference did not reach statistical significance at any time-point.

Fig. 3. IFN ELISpot responses post-vaccination for intramuscular and intradermal routes. (A) Shows responses to 85A summed pooled peptides calculated by summing across all peptide pools A–G at each time-point. This could potentially result in duplicate counting of cells that responded to any of the 10mer overlap regions, since these could occur in two pools with adjacent peptides, but allows direct comparison with immunogenicity data from previous trials with MVA85A. (B) Shows responses to the 85A single pool and (C) to PPD.

claim_6.claim: Ex vivo IFN ELISpot assay analysis of fresh peripheral blood mononuclear cells from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intradermal MVA85A (n = 12) and intramuscular MVA85A (n = 12) at screening and 1, 2, 4, 12 and 24 weeks post-vaccination showed no difference in the breadth of Ag85A peptide-pool IFN responses between the intradermal and intramuscular groups.

sources.quote: However, there was no difference in the breath of response across the peptide pools between the two groups.

claim_7.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of cryopreserved peripheral blood mononuclear cells from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intradermal MVA85A (n = 12) at weeks 0, 1 and 24 post-vaccination showed that PPD- and 85A-specific CD4+ T-cell IFNγ, TNFα and IL2 production was significantly induced at weeks 1 and 24 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both routes of vaccination induced significant IFN, TNFα and IL2 at weeks 1 and 24 post vaccination.

claim_8.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of cryopreserved peripheral blood mononuclear cells from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intramuscular MVA85A (n = 12) at weeks 0, 1 and 24 post-vaccination showed that PPD- and 85A-specific CD4+ T-cell IFNγ, TNFα and IL2 production was significantly induced at weeks 1 and 24 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Both routes of vaccination induced significant IFN, TNFα and IL2 at weeks 1 and 24 post vaccination.

claim_9.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of cryopreserved peripheral blood mononuclear cells from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intradermal MVA85A (n = 12) and intramuscular MVA85A (n = 12) at weeks 0, 1 and 24 post-vaccination showed no significant difference in PPD- and 85A-specific CD4+ T-cell IFNγ, TNFα and IL2 production between the intradermal and intramuscular groups.

sources.quote: Levels of produced cytokines between the two groups did not significantly differ at any time-point.

Fig. 4. Mycobacteria-specific cytokine responses in cryopreserved PBMC stimulated overnight with PPD or 85A peptide pools. Comparable levels of PPD (A) and 85A-specific (B) IFN, TNFα and IL2 were detected with no significant differences between the two vaccination groups at any time-point (Mann Whitney U test). Significant cytokine production was detected at all time-points compared to baseline (p < 0.05, Wilcoxon matched pairs test). Polyfunctional PPD and 85A-specific CD4+ T cells (C) producing multiple cytokines were detected following vaccination. The patterns of cytokine production are comparable between both groups.

claim_11.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of cryopreserved peripheral blood mononuclear cells from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intradermal MVA85A (n = 12) and intramuscular MVA85A (n = 12) at weeks 0, 1 and 2 post-vaccination showed no significant difference in CD4+ T-cell expression of CCR4, CCR6, CCR7 and CXCR3 between the intradermal and intramuscular groups.

sources.quote: Substantial levels of expression were detected in both groups, which were not significantly different.

claim_12.claim: IgG enzyme linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) analysis of serum samples from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intradermal MVA85A (n = 12) at weeks 0, 2, 4 and 24 post-vaccination showed that Antigen 85A-specific IgG was higher at week 4 (day 28) compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Volunteers who were vaccinated intradermally with MVA85A had significantly higher serum IgG 4 weeks post-vaccination when compared to baseline (p = 0.0342) and week-2 (p = 0.0005).

Fig. 5. Serum IgG. Antigen 85A-specific IgG was measured in samples from subjects in the ID and IM groups (12 subjects in each group) at weeks 0, 2, 4 and 24. Median OD values are shown with individual values for each volunteer.

claim_14.claim: IgG enzyme linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) analysis of serum samples from BCG-vaccinated healthy adults randomized to intramuscular MVA85A (n = 12) at weeks 0, 2, 4 and 24 post-vaccination showed no significant increase in Antigen 85A-specific IgG during follow-up compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: There was no significant increase during follow-up in IgG levels in the intramuscularly immunised group, similarly no significant differences were observed between the two groups at any of the time points.
